score.title: Score
score.description: Decision score; not a calibrated probability

dataset_uri.description: The world that answered this mention, e.g. `wordlift://dataset/me` or `wikidata://public`.

anyOf.title: DecisionSignals
anyOf.description: How the decision was reached; present whenever the engine ranked candidates.

path.description: `fast` (exact dictionary hit, model skipped), `reranked` (public world), `vocabulary` (your dataset)

X-Wordlift-Consumption.description: The request's cost in smart credits: one per request plus one per 1,000 characters of text.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Monthly allowance of the account for resolve().

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Credits left in the current period.

401.description: Missing or invalid WordLift API key (`unauthorized`).

schema.title: Problem
schema.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details, Content-Type application/problem+json. `code` is the engine's stable error code and `type` is derived from it; extension members carry what the route knows (dataset_uri, mention, accepted, retry_after_s, errors).

detail.description: A human-readable sentence, when the engine has one.

code.description: Stable error code: unauthorized, invalid_request, invalid_span, invalid_identity, dataset_not_supported, dataset_required, invalid_dataset, unknown_include, candidates_not_supported, dataset_warming, dataset_unavailable.

errors.description: On invalid_request: one entry per failing field.

422.description: The body fails validation (`invalid_request`, with `errors`) or the request is refused: `invalid_span`, `invalid_identity`, `dataset_not_supported`, `dataset_required`, `invalid_dataset`, `unknown_include`, `candidates_not_supported`.
